# QUAD Academy

> Live online board-exam preparation for Class 10 students in India (CBSE, ICSE and State Boards). Small live batches for Maths and Science taught by a real teacher, a scored mock test every Sunday, weekly parent reports on WhatsApp, and free revision videos on YouTube. A sister concern of OurSchoolHouse (ourschoolhouse.in), India's homeschooling support portal.

## Board Boost · Batch 1 (CBSE Class 10, Board 2027)
- Dates: Mon 7 Dec 2026 to Sat 16 Jan 2027 (6 weeks), live online, 25–40 students per batch
- Maths Board Boost (Maths Standard 041): Mon, Wed, Fri, 6:30–7:30 pm IST, teacher Shwetha J
- Science Board Boost (086): Tue, Thu, Sat, 6:30–7:30 pm IST, teacher Mihir R Shreshti
- Each batch: 18 live classes, 6 weekly board-pattern mocks (Sunday, 90 min), 6 parent score reports on WhatsApp, 24×7 doubt group, answer books and notes, a free last-week doubt clinic
- Fees: one subject ₹1,499 (early bird to 25 Nov 2026; ₹1,999 after); both subjects ₹2,499 (₹2,999 after). Bring a friend: both get ₹500 off. Full refund if the child leaves after the first class.
- Every class is recorded; live classes and long-answer marking are done by a real teacher, not AI.

## Try first
- [₹49 Board Masterclass](https://quadacademy.org/masterclass/) (2 hours live; Maths: Shwetha J, Science: Mihir R Shreshti): the 20 questions that come almost every year, solved live, with a PDF to keep and a doubt session. Maths Sun 22 Nov 2026, Science Sun 29 Nov 2026, 10:30 am–12:30 pm IST. Book on WhatsApp; the ₹49 is adjusted if you join a batch.
- Free Sunday Board Booster: 45-minute class on the QUAD YouTube channel, Sundays 6:00–6:45 pm IST.
- Winter Break Intensive: Sat 26 Dec 2026 to Sun 3 Jan 2027, Maths 10–11 am, Science 11:15 am–12:15 pm, ₹499 per subject, ₹899 both, free for Batch 1 students.
- One-to-one tuition is available on request.

## Teachers
- Shwetha J: co-founder of QUAD Academy, MA, MEd, 15+ years teaching Class 8–10 Maths and Science across CBSE, ICSE, State Board and NIOS; founder of Learn with Shwetha (one-to-one board-exam tuition, Bangalore); teaches the Maths batch.
- Mihir R Shreshti: created, manages and runs OurSchoolHouse; co-founder of QUAD Academy; IIT Madras alumnus, homeschooled and cleared Class 10 and 12 through NIOS; teaches the Science batch.
- Shubha M: co-founder and manager of QUAD Academy; idea provider, educational consultant and content designer for OurSchoolHouse; 25+ years of teaching and content creation; plans courses, sets and marks mocks, writes parent reports, handles admissions.

## Free revision
- [QUAD Academy home](https://quadacademy.org/): free important-question videos for every Class 10 Maths and Science chapter, chapter notes and PDFs, board paper walkthroughs
- [QUAD Quest](https://quadacademy.org/quest.html): free chapter-by-chapter practice game with real board questions, points and streaks
- [Free revision PDFs](https://quadacademy.org/free/): free CBSE Class 10 Maths and Science complete chapter guides and revision notes for every chapter, mind maps, solutions books (linked from each chapter video) and board-pattern mock tests with answer keys; no sign-up
- [QUAD Blog](https://quadacademy.org/blog/): free articles with real CBSE Class 10 board questions solved step by step, common mistakes and study plans

## Blog posts (newest first)
- [Metals and Non-metals Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 3, Reactivity Series)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/metals-and-non-metals-board-questions/) (2026-11-19): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 3 solved: metals with water and acids, the reactivity series, displacement in salt solutions, alloys, extraction and the ionic bond in MgO, with the trap in each question.
- [Light Reflection and Refraction Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 9, Mirror and Lens Formula)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/light-reflection-refraction-board-questions/) (2026-11-18): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 9 solved: convex and concave lens numericals, negative magnification, refractive index and speed of light, and the rear-view mirror, with the sign-convention trap in each.
- [Acids, Bases and Salts Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 2, pH and Litmus)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/acids-bases-and-salts-board-questions/) (2026-11-17): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 2 solved: litmus, baking powder, nature of salts, CuO + HCl, the pH case study, Plaster of Paris and three give-reasons questions, with the trap in each.
- [Heredity Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 8, Punnett Squares)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/heredity-board-questions/) (2026-11-16): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 8 Heredity solved: monohybrid and dihybrid Punnett squares, 1:2:1 and 9:3:3:1 ratios, inherited vs acquired traits, and sex determination (44 + XY).
- [How Do Organisms Reproduce: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 7)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/how-do-organisms-reproduce-board-questions/) (2026-11-15): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 7 solved: DNA copying and variation, fission, budding, regeneration, spores, vegetative propagation, flowers, pollination, human reproduction and health.
- [Control and Coordination: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 6)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/control-and-coordination-board-questions/) (2026-11-14): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 6 solved: neuron and synapse, reflex arc, parts of the brain, plant movements and tropisms, plant hormones, endocrine glands and feedback.
- [Life Processes: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 5)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/life-processes-board-questions/) (2026-11-13): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 5 solved: photosynthesis, stomata, digestion enzymes, aerobic vs anaerobic respiration, double circulation, xylem and phloem, and the nephron.
- [Carbon and its Compounds: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 4)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/carbon-and-its-compounds-board-questions/) (2026-11-12): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 4 solved: homologous series, soap micelles, isomers, conductivity, glacial acetic acid, identify-the-compound and why carbon shares electrons.
- [Coordinate Geometry: 6 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 7)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/coordinate-geometry-board-questions/) (2026-11-09): CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 7 solved: distance formula, equidistant points, proving a square, section formula, ratio from an axis and the parallelogram trick, with marking tips.
- [Introduction to Trigonometry: 5 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 8)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/introduction-to-trigonometry-board-questions/) (2026-11-08): CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 8 solved: one ratio to all six, standard-angle values, finding A and B, and identity proofs, with marking tips and common traps.
- [Heights and Distances: 4 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 9)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/heights-and-distances-board-questions/) (2026-11-07): CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 9 Some Applications of Trigonometry solved: kite string, walking towards a tower, two ships from a lighthouse, building and tower.
- [How to Use Previous-Year Questions the Smart Way (Class 10)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/previous-year-questions-smart-way/) (2026-11-06): A seven-step method for using CBSE Class 10 previous-year questions properly: sort by type, pause and try, mark mistakes in three colours, keep an error list and practise under time.
- [Chemical Reactions and Equations: 3 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science)](https://quadacademy.org/blog/chemical-reactions-equations-board-questions/) (2026-11-06): CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 1 board questions solved step by step: heating lead nitrate, the barium chloride precipitation reaction, and the oxidising-agent trap, with marking tips.
